How this works

Choose a market, product, ranking rule and decision time. The app selects one strategy, then races it against the best similar, opposite, overall and best win rate strategies from that moment on, replayed from stored snapshots. Data from is embedded in this file; only information available at the decision time is used to choose who races.

Where this comes from

This explorer is a simplified, static version of the strategy directory's Scenario & Criteria Universal Engine, the full interactive tool that ranks strategies, replays a day and follows the leaders. The screen below is that tool: forex, GBPAUD_C, Friday 9 October 2026, replayed to 14:45. It is one example, not the data in this file.

  • Return (top left): Net Return or Alt Net. Here this is the Net | Alt net switch.
  • Scenario, day, type, product: how strategies are picked (here Top Buy Sell, forex, GBPAUD_C). Here these are the asset class, product and scenario choices.
  • Replay and baseline: the day is replayed from 00:00 to a replay head (14:45); only snapshots at or before that time are used. Here this is the hour you choose.
  • Select top #1 at a time, auto-add every 15 minutes: each new leader is added to the same chart. Here this is the idea behind switching only when a better strategy appears.
  • The chart: each line is one selected strategy's cumulative net return through the day; the marked points show when it became #1. Sharp steps are large moves in the cumulative net.

What is different here: one file, no server, a fixed data time, crypto and forex kept separate, and the result shown as a race you can replay.

What do “net”, “win rate” and “three closed positions” mean?

Net is the platform’s cumulative result in its own units, including open and closed positions. Win rate is the share of closed positions with a positive result. A strategy needs at least three closed positions at the decision time to be chosen to race.

Historical and analytical only. One day (), replayed from stored snapshots embedded in this file. It is not investment advice, a signal, a forecast or an execution workflow. Net is the five-minute snapshot measure the platform records; the race shows the change in it since the decision time.
